summary: Successfully implemented ReadOnlyView for MeteredKeyValueStore. Added readOnly(IsolationLevel) method that returns a MeteredReadOnlyKeyValueStore implementing ReadOnlyKeyValueStore<K, V>. The implementation applies metering and serdes to all read operations (get, range, reverseRange, all, reverseAll, prefixScan, approximateNumEntries). All 42 tests in MeteredKeyValueStoreTest pass, including 9 new tests for read-only view functionality.
